title: FUNCUT edit plan
description: The one-pass plan a director emits after measuring, before cutting. Times are seconds unless a field says otherwise.

niche.description: The niche playbook in use, e.g. history, tech, luxury, motivation, finance, science, horror, fitness, gaming, howto.

segments.description: The timeline, in order. Segment i covers [start, end); gaps or overlaps are plan errors.

spoken.description: The narration words this segment covers (for caption grouping).

emotion.description: What this segment's narration FEELS like, from the `emotion` tool's read of the transcript (action extract). The layer every other per-segment choice answers to: the easing, the colour push, the SFX register, the stock vocabulary.

act.description: The dramaturgical act this segment plays - the emotion read assigns it, the plan's sections may override it. Drives the shot register (extreme close-up for a hook, wide establishing for setup, hero shot for the reveal) and the BGM duck depth.

oneOf.description: The exact concat-motion authoring curve object the emotion read returns ({kind: bezier|spring, ...}).

easing.description: How this segment's motion enters, from the emotion: tense lines ease in, warm ones ease out, a burst pops, anger snaps.

colourTemp.description: The colour-temperature push this segment rides on top of the base grade, from the emotion read (fear is cold and crushed, joy golden and lifted, disgust sickly).

duckDb.description: How deep the BGM ducks under this segment's speech, as an absolute dB target from the act's profile in the emotion read (-15 under the naked hook, -9 letting the reveal ride).

type.description: broll = OpenVid clip; textCard/titleCard = styled text over background (fallbacks); existing = footage already imported.

query.description: broll: the openvid_search query. Follow prompts/broll_matching.md.

clipId.description: A real OpenVid clip id or existing timeline clip id, returned by a tool; never invented.

mediaId.description: For existing footage: the media-bin id returned by project_get/timeline_read.

file.description: For a source file not yet represented by a clip or media id: its actual path.

trimIn.description: Seconds into the source where the clip starts.

trimOut.description: Seconds into the source where it ends (leave longer than the segment; trim after placing).

preset.description: textCard/titleCard: one of the 31 text presets, e.g. concat.impact, concat.lower-third, concat.bold-caption.

fit.description: fill = clip_frame framing 'fill' (cover + crop; the default on every aspect mismatch - OpenVid is landscape-only, so 9:16 canvases fill from landscape sources). blurPlate = timeline_background blur as a deliberate style. A letterboxed frame at review is a defect.

query.description: sounds_search query using a real category: Whoosh, Impact, Riser, Motion, UI, Notification, Keyboard, Digital, Foley, Writing, Ambience, Music.

peakAt.description: The time the sound's PEAK must land on — usually the segment's first frame.

gainDb.description: An absolute dB target; 0 dB is unity, negative levels attenuate, and -60 dB is the editor's silence floor. Typical SFX support levels are around -12 to -6 dB.

effect.description: One of the 122 transition ids, e.g. concat.dissolve, concat.whip-pan, concat.glitch-transition, concat.punch-in.

captions.description: Whether captions are included for this segment; timing is segment-level, not word-aligned. Null = follow the video default.

cutType.description: How this segment begins; the twelve-cut vocabulary in prompts/cuts_and_pacing.md. A run of six hards is a pacing smell.

in.description: The entrance; hard floor M: every clip enters on purpose.

anim.description: static = deliberate, at most one per piece.

out.description: The exit or hand-off; section boundaries exit, interiors hand off.

comp.description: The designed beat on this segment (motion_bake / captions_animate). Density floor: one per section, one per 15 s.

ops.description: Authoring operations: set-slot, set-text, set-words, retime, pop, fade-in, ...

hold.description: Seconds the comp holds on screen.

source.description: tts = tts_generate made it; file = user-provided.

voice.description: TTS voice id (Kokoro 0-52; e.g. 2 af_bella, 8 af_river, 11 am_adam).

duckDb.description: Absolute music level under speech in dB; a negative target attenuates from unity. Convert through clip_audio_levels_db; never pass this number directly as the engine's linear volume.

captions.description: Video-wide caption style; the current transcription/caption pipeline provides segment timing, not word alignment. Per-segment flags override presence only.

syncMode.description: Only segment-level timing is supported; do not claim word-level synchronization.

fontSize.description: Fraction of frame height; 0.04 engine default, 0.05-0.06 for short-form.

offsetY.description: Fraction from center; positive is lower.

background.description: Optional plate '#rrggbb[aa]' for readability; null = no plate.

grade.description: Required. A video with no grade is a rough cut.

filter.description: One of the 57 filter ids, e.g. concat.teal-orange, concat.noir, concat.warm.

intensityKey.description: The package's own intensity param key from effects_list (concat.teal-orange -> 'amount' 0-100; concat.warm/cool -> 'temperature' in K).

intensity.description: Value within the param's min/max from effects_list.

apply.description: layer = ONE effect_layer_add {start: 0, duration: <runtime>} with duration WRITTEN (absent defaults to 5 s - the trap); perClip = the same videoEffects chain on every clip.

platform.description: youtube, shorts, reels, tiktok — sets loudness/length expectations only.

mode.description: reel = retention engineering (<= 60 s, hook in 3 s, loop or single CTA, interrupts every 2-4 s); longform = an argument with chapters (> 60 s, hook -> title -> chapters -> re-hook at the 50-60% dip -> outro CTA). See prompts/reels_vs_longform.md.

sections.description: The piece's structure, by role. Reel: hook + body + cta. Longform: hook + intro + body(chapters) + cta + outro. Boundaries align to segments.

maxSegmentSeconds.description: Hard floor P: no visual segment runs past this (4.0 energetic niches, 6.0 calm).

text.description: The one text system: tokens fixed here, zones in prompts/text_animation.md.

ink.description: #rrggbb - white over dark/busy footage, near-black over bright.

accent.description: #rrggbb - ONE accent per video: active caption words, chapter bars, stat numbers.

creativeBrief.description: The WHY of the piece. A plan without this is structurally valid but creatively unready: plan_validate reports creativeReady=false and lists blockers. Set it with creative_brief before planning.

audience.description: Who this is for, specifically enough to choose shots for. Not 'everyone' - name the person, their problem and what they already believe.

platform.description: Where it plays (tiktok, reels, shorts, youtube, ...). Determines hook length, safe margins and pacing.

goal.description: What the viewer should think, feel or do after the last frame.

thesis.description: The one sentence the whole video argues or reveals. Every shot serves it.

curiosityGap.description: The question opened in the first 1-2 seconds. It must be answerable by the payoff.

payoff.description: What resolves the curiosityGap. If this is weak, no amount of motion will save the edit.

emotionalArc.description: Three or more emotional beats in order. Either an array of strings (e.g. ['unease','wonder','relief']) or one string separated by '->' or commas.

referenceStyle.description: A director/editor/show whose rhythm and taste this cut borrows from, and what exactly to borrow.

tone.description: Voice and attitude: e.g. dry, urgent, awed, conspiratorial.

brandKit.description: Colours, fonts, logo/end-card rules. Object or a short string.

constraints.description: Hard limits: runtime, footage you must use, claims you cannot make.

avoid.description: Clichés and stock shots to refuse (e.g. generic handshake, lens flare, waving flag).
